corrected_proposal.full_proposal_markdown:
# Proposal: Warehouse Visibility Platform for NordFrame Logistics

**Submitted by:** Clarion Data Systems

## Executive Summary
Clarion Data Systems is pleased to submit this enhanced proposal to deliver a centralized web-based inventory dashboard for NordFrame Logistics GmbH. Spanning your 6 regional warehouses in Germany and Austria, our solution integrates directly with your existing PostgreSQL database, enforces strict role-based access control, and guarantees a phased rollout meeting your exact 3-month pilot and 6-month full deployment timeline.

## Proposed Solution
- **Dashboard**: Real-time inventory levels across all 6 warehouses, built on top of your existing PostgreSQL database with zero database migration required.
- **Low-stock alerts**: Configurable thresholds per item, notifying warehouse managers automatically via email and in-app banners.
- **Role-based access**: Warehouse managers see only their own site's data; HQ staff have visibility across all sites.
- **Rollout approach**: A structured onboarding plan executing a working pilot at one warehouse within 3 months, followed by systematic phased rollouts to the remaining 5 sites within 6 months.

## Timeline & Implementation
- **Weeks 1–4**: Discovery, system architecture finalization, and stakeholder alignment.
- **Weeks 5–12**: Pilot implementation and deployment at the first regional warehouse.
- **Weeks 13–26**: Phased rollout across the remaining 5 warehouses in Germany and Austria.

## Pricing & Commercial Terms
Our firm fixed price for this project scope is **€98,000**, fully inclusive of software development, pilot testing, multi-site deployment, user training, and the first year of comprehensive support and maintenance. This sits comfortably within your stated budget of €80,000–€120,000.

## Support, SLAs & Maintenance
We provide 12 months of post-go-live support including:
- **Uptime SLA**: 99.9% platform availability.
- **Incident Response Times**: Severity 1 (2 hours), Severity 2 (4 hours), Severity 3 (24 hours).

## Assumptions, Limitations & Risks
- **Assumption**: Stable network connectivity and read-access permissions to the existing PostgreSQL database across all regional locations.
- **Risk Mitigation**: Potential query performance bottlenecks on the legacy database will be mitigated via optimized indexing and read-replica caching.

## Why Clarion
Clarion has successfully delivered inventory and logistics dashboards for several mid-size distribution companies across the DACH region, combining technical excellence with rigorous project governance.
